name: Shobach
bio: Shobach (called Shophach in 1 Chronicles 19:16, 18) was the commander of Hadadezer's army, brought out to lead the Arameans from beyond the Euphrates after their first defeat at the hands of Joab and Abishai. David himself led Israel out to meet them at Helam, where the Arameans were routed again; David killed the men of seven hundred Aramean chariots and forty thousand horsemen, and struck down Shobach, who died there. The defeat was so decisive that all the kings who had served Hadadezer made peace with Israel, and the Arameans never again dared help the Ammonites (2 Samuel 10:15-19).
